gaps.sentence: She can't afford ___ her car repaired this month.
gaps.explanation: afford + to-infinitive: can't afford to get.

gaps.sentence: She keeps ___ about the exam results.
He was made ___ for the damage to the rental car.
gaps.explanation: In the passive, 'be made to do' takes the to-infinitive.

gaps.sentence: Do you have any idea how ___ this knot?
gaps.explanation: question word + to-infinitive: how to undo.
can't stand + -ing (also to-infinitive in AmE): can't stand waiting. -ing accepted as standard.

gaps.sentence: She's considering ___ the flat and moving to the coast.
It started ___ just as we left the house.
gaps.explanation: start/begin take either -ing or to-infinitive; with continuous or states, 'to' is preferred. Both accepted.

gaps.sentence: I've always wanted ___ how to sail.
